AaveV3InstancesMeta.$comment: Meta-adapter (ADR 0010): one immutable adapter serving every Aave V3 instance. Supersedes AaveV3_Gnosis (removed from config 2026-11).

StakeWiseV3VaultsMeta.$comment: StakeWise V3 vaults on Gnosis (GNO staking + osGNO debt, both denominated in GNO). Instances are the Gnosis vault addresses held by balancer-dao (0x0EFc…fc89) and CoW (0x616d…0669): 0x00025c… + 0x2cd404… (balancer) and 0x4b4406… (balancer + cow). GNO + osGNO are registered+priced on Gnosis. Reconciled on NAV via addMetaInstances/removeMetaInstances.

UniswapV3PoolsMeta.$comment: Active Uniswap V3 pool set on Gnosis. Both tokens of a pool MUST be registered assets or the whole instance is dropped (NAV values an LP from the sum of its two legs, so a half-priced LP would understate it) - all seven below are pairs of chain-100 registered assets. SELECTION: the factory was queried for every pair x fee-tier combination of the 11 registered chain-100 assets (2026-08-26), which found 24 live pools; these are the seven holding more than $10k, together ~$3.4M of the ~$3.4M total. The other 17 are empty or dust and are deliberately omitted because _instancePositions re-enumerates an account's NFTs ONCE PER CONFIGURED POOL - the cost is O(pools x NFTs), so an empty pool is pure overhead on every NAV read for every Gnosis account. Adding one later is an addMetaInstances config TX, not a deploy. Omitted (all ~$0): WETH/sDAI 500, WXDAI/WETH 500, wstETH/GNO 3000, sDAI/EURe 500+3000, wstETH/sDAI 3000+10000, WETH/GNO 3000, WETH/EURe 3000, sDAI/GNO 3000, osGNO/sDAI 3000, osGNO/WXDAI 10000, USDCe/GNO 500+10000, USDCe/GHO 100, WXDAI/GNO 3000, WXDAI/sDAI 100. NOTE the under-report direction: a position in an UNconfigured pool is silently skipped, never over-reported. RE-RUN TRIGGER: that selection is a point-in-time query (2026-08-26) and nothing re-runs it. Re-run it when chain-100 drift appears in the comparison report, or when a covered account mints a Uniswap V3 position on this chain. Materiality lives in ACCOUNT HOLDINGS, not pool TVL — a large pool none of it karpatkey's is irrelevant, and a small position in an omitted pool is not. The Gnosis COW/WETH pool is excluded PERMANENTLY and is not a candidate at any TVL: COW is unpriceable, and NAV values an LP as the sum of its legs, so wiring it would report about half the position. See chains.100.$untracked_by_design in test/integration/accounts.json.

LidoStakedEthWalletMeta.$comment: Wallet-held yield tokens (ADR 0010 meta family). Each instance below is the yield TOKEN's own address, which is also a registered priced asset - that is what makes this value-neutral: the adapter reports balanceOf and NAVCalculator prices the asset it already priced, so only the identity changes. Reclassifies wstETH from `wallet`/`Wallet` to `lido`/`Staking`. ORDERING: the asset must be REGISTERED BEFORE it is claimed here - registerAsset refuses to arm the default adapter for an already-claimed token (MetaInstanceClaimedByAnotherAdapter), a hard revert rather than a silent double-count. The standard order (RegisterAssets, then 06_Configure) satisfies this.
